name: DataTable
description: A powerful compound data table component built on TanStack Table with server-side pagination, sorting, filtering, column visibility, row selection, column reordering via drag-and-drop, and loading states. Uses the useDataTable hook for centralized state management. Designed for complex backoffice tables that require advanced interactivity — for simple static tables, use the Table component instead.

blocks.content:
The `useDataTable` hook centralizes **all** table state in one place. It manages pagination, sorting, column filters, column visibility, column order, and row selection. It returns state values, setters, and `onXxxChange` aliases that match DataTable prop names — so `{...tableState}` wires everything up automatically.

We recommend using the hook for all DataTable usage. However, if you prefer, you can manage state yourself with `useState` and pass props individually to `<DataTable>` — the component accepts both approaches.

### What the hook manages

The hook handles ALL table state internally. You do NOT need separate `useState` calls for any of these:

- **pagination** — `{ pageIndex, pageSize }` — current page and rows per page
- **sorting** — `[{ id, desc }]` — which columns are sorted and their direction
- **columnFilters** — `[{ id, value }]` — active filters per column
- **columnVisibility** — `{ [columnId]: boolean }` — which columns are visible/hidden
- **columnOrder** — `string[]` — display order of columns
- **rowSelection** — `{ [rowIndex]: boolean }` — which rows are selected

All of these are spread onto `<DataTable>` via `{...tableState}`. The only props you still pass manually are:
- `columns` — your column definitions
- `data` — the fetched data array
- `pageCount` — total pages from API (`Math.ceil(total / pageSize)`)
- `enableRowSelection` — boolean to enable checkboxes (config, not state)
- `enableColumnReordering` — boolean to enable drag-and-drop (config, not state)
- `isLoading` / `loadingRowCount` — loading state you manage from your fetch logic
### Options

rows: Initial number of rows per page.
Prefix for URL params when multiple tables share the same page. Example: 'shipments' produces ?shipments_page=1&shipments_pageSize=10.
Next.js router instance. When provided, table state (pagination, sorting, filters) is synced to the URL automatically.
Next.js searchParams for reading initial state from URL on first render.

blocks.content:
### Returns

For each state the hook returns three things: the value, a setter, and an `onXxxChange` alias. The alias is the same reference as the setter — it exists so `{...tableState}` maps directly to DataTable prop names.

rows: Setter for pagination state. Both are the same reference.
Object mapping column IDs to boolean.
Array of column IDs for display order.
Object mapping row indices to boolean. Access selected rows via Object.keys(tableState.rowSelection).
True while a URL transition is pending (only relevant when router is provided).
Serializes pagination, sorting, and filters into URLSearchParams for API calls.

blocks.content: ### Basic usage

const tableState = useDataTable();

<DataTable columns={columns} data={data} pageCount={pageCount} {...tableState}>
  <DataTableContent />
  <DataTablePagination />
</DataTable>
### With row selection
### With URL synchronization

### DataTableContent

Renders the table body with headers, rows, loading skeletons, and empty state. Must be placed inside `<DataTable>`. Reads table state from internal context — no props needed.

### DataTableToolbar

A flex container for filter inputs, action buttons, and view options above the table. Place inside `<DataTable>` before `<DataTableContent>`.

rows: Filter inputs, buttons, DataTableViewOptions, or any controls.

blocks.content:
### DataTableColumnHeader

Sortable column header. Renders a ghost Button with sort indicators (ChevronUp/ChevronDown/ChevronsUpDown). When `enableColumnReordering` is active, also renders a GripVertical drag handle. Use in the column definition's `header` property.

rows: TanStack Table column instance from header render function.
Display text for the column header.

blocks.content:
### DataTableViewOptions

Dropdown menu button (Settings2 icon) to toggle column visibility. Shows columns with `enableHiding !== false`. Place inside `<DataTableToolbar>`. Reads table instance from context when inside `<DataTable>`.

### DataTablePagination

Pagination controls with rows-per-page selector, page indicator, and navigation buttons (first/prev/next/last). The rows-per-page selector automatically includes the current pageSize in its options even if it's not in the default list. Shows selected row count when rows are selected. Place as the last child inside `<DataTable>`. Hide during loading: `{!isLoading && <DataTablePagination />}`.

rows: Page size options in the rows-per-page selector. The current pageSize is always included automatically.
Shows 'X of Y row(s) selected' when rows are selected.

blocks.content: Columns use the `ColumnDef<TData>[]` type, re-exported from the design system so consumers never need `@tanstack/react-table` directly. Common patterns:

Use `DateRangePicker` (from `@traxion-global/design-system/react`) for date range filters in `DataTableToolbar`. It replaces the manual Calendar+Popover+Button pattern with a single self-contained component that handles the trigger button, popover open/close, Apply/Clear logic, and locale formatting. For a single-date filter use `DatePicker`. **Never use `<input type="date">`** — it bypasses design system styling, locale support, and accessibility.
For time-of-day filters (e.g. filtering by hour in a report or log table), use `TimePicker` in the toolbar:

props.name: columns
props.description: Array of TanStack Table column definitions. Import ColumnDef from the design system. Each column defines header, accessorKey or accessorFn, optional cell renderer, and column-level features (enableSorting, enableHiding, size).

props.name: data
props.description: Array of row data objects. Typically fetched from an API. The data must match the shape expected by the column definitions.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages. Calculated as Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize). Required because DataTable uses server-side (manual) pagination.

props.name: pagination
props.description: Controlled pagination state: { pageIndex: number, pageSize: number }. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: onPaginationChange
props.description: Pagination change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: sorting
props.description: Controlled sorting state. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onSortingChange
props.description: Sorting change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: columnFilters
props.description: Controlled column filters state. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnFiltersChange
props.description: Column filters change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Controlled row selection state. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}. Access selected rows via Object.keys(tableState.rowSelection).

props.name: onRowSelectionChange
props.description: Row selection change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.description: Enables row selection. This is a config flag, NOT state — pass it directly (not from the hook). Set to true to allow all rows, or pass a function for conditional selection per row.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Custom row ID getter. Useful for stable selection across page changes. If not provided, TanStack Table uses the row index.

props.name: columnVisibility
props.description: Controlled column visibility state. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnVisibilityChange
props.description: Column visibility change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Controlled column order state. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}. If not provided, managed internally.

props.name: onColumnOrderChange
props.description: Column order change handler. Provided by useDataTable via {...tableState}.

props.name: enableColumnReordering
props.description: Enables drag-and-drop column reordering. This is a config flag, NOT state — pass it directly (not from the hook). When true, DataTableColumnHeader renders a drag handle.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: When true, DataTableContent renders skeleton rows instead of data. Headers are still visible. Hide DataTablePagination during loading: {!isLoading && <DataTablePagination />}.

props.name: loadingRowCount
props.description: Number of skeleton rows to render when isLoading is true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Custom empty state rendered when data array is empty and isLoading is false. Defaults to NoDataMessage component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default 'space-y-4' wrapper styling.

props.name: children
props.description: Compound children. Use DataTableToolbar, DataTableContent, DataTablePagination, and DataTableViewOptions as children. If no children are provided, renders DataTableContent by default.

accessibility.role: table (native HTML semantics via the underlying Table component)
accessibility.keyboard: Tab navigates through interactive elements (sort buttons, checkboxes, action buttons, pagination controls). Sort buttons toggle direction on Enter/Space. Drag handles support keyboard reordering via arrow keys. Pagination buttons are keyboard accessible with sr-only labels.
accessibility.aria: Row selection state conveyed via data-[state=selected] on TableRow. Checkbox columns use aria-label for screen readers. Drag handles use aria-label='Drag to reorder column'. Pagination buttons have sr-only text ('Go to first page', 'Go to previous page', etc.). Sort direction indicated visually via icons (ChevronUp for asc, ChevronDown for desc, ChevronsUpDown for unsorted).
accessibility.notes: The table renders inside a 'rounded-md border' container. Loading state preserves table headers and renders animated skeleton bars for body cells. Empty state renders a full-width NoDataMessage inside the table body — headers remain visible so users understand the page context. When enableColumnReordering is true, DndContext is only initialized after client-side hydration to prevent SSR mismatches.

do: Use the useDataTable() hook for state management — it handles pagination, sorting, filters, column visibility, column order, and row selection. Spread it onto DataTable: {...tableState}
Always include <DataTablePagination /> — every backoffice table must have pagination
Reset pagination to page 0 when filters change: useEffect(() => { tableState.setPagination(prev => ({ ...prev, pageIndex: 0 })); }, [tableState.columnFilters])
Use useDebouncedCallback for filter inputs to avoid excessive API calls while the user types
Set enableSorting: false and enableHiding: false on action and checkbox columns
Use DataTableColumnHeader for any column that should be sortable — it provides consistent sort indicators
Set a column id (e.g., id: 'Name') when using DataTableViewOptions so the toggle menu shows human-readable names instead of accessorKey paths
Include tableState.sorting and tableState.columnFilters in your useEffect dependencies when they are used
Use the cell render function with row.original to access the full row data object for custom cell content
Use mixed-content cells (multiple lines in one cell) for related data that doesn't justify its own column
Use icons from lucide-react only — never emoji, unicode, or other icon libraries
Place DataTableViewOptions inside DataTableToolbar for consistent layout
Access selected rows via Object.keys(tableState.rowSelection) — no separate useState needed
Use DateRangePicker for date range filters in DataTableToolbar — it replaces the manual Calendar+Popover pattern with a single component.
Use DatePicker for single-date filters in DataTableToolbar.
Use TimePicker for time-of-day filters in DataTableToolbar or filter panels.
Never use <input type="date"> or <input type="time"> directly — always use DatePicker, DateRangePicker, or TimePicker.
dont: Don't use DataTable for simple static tables — use the Table component instead

Don't create separate useState() calls for pagination, sorting, filters, column visibility, column order, or row selection — useDataTable() manages all of these. If you prefer custom handlers, you can pass props individually instead of using the hook
Don't import from @tanstack/react-table directly — import ColumnDef, Row, Column from @traxion-global/design-system/react
Don't use client-side pagination — DataTable is designed for server-side (manual) pagination only
Don't forget to pass pageCount — it is required for server-side pagination to work
Don't show DataTablePagination while isLoading is true — it will show stale data
Don't use enableColumnReordering without DataTableColumnHeader on the columns — the drag handle is rendered by DataTableColumnHeader
Don't create separate columns for closely related data (city + state + country) — use a multi-line cell instead
Don't hardcode color values — use semantic Tailwind classes (text-muted-foreground, text-destructive, etc.)
